INSERT INTO webhook_delivery
             (id, tenant_id, endpoint_id, event_type, payload_json, attempts, next_attempt_at,
              status, created_at)
         SELECT d.id, $3, d.endpoint_id, $4, $5, 0, $6, 'pending', $6
           FROM unnest($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[]) AS d (id, endpoint_id)
